comparison.objective: Extend an assistive-equipment handle to a selected length and engage its detent, versus tune damping and validate stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Holding a withdrawal pin clear during telescoping extension and then engaging it differs from recessed hex-bit torque, bit withdrawal, collar rotation, moved-socket reacquisition, and iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: The record requires measured extension and positive detent engagement, rejecting early pin return; the candidate requires two force/travel-bounded impact cycles and retained collar angle after setscrew locking.
comparison.reason: This is the closest adjustment-and-locking record, but it tests discrete linear detent selection, while the candidate tests continuous rotary tuning plus dynamic performance validation.
